subject: Models
source_sentence: All the models we explore take as input the voting record (denoted V) for a politician p, the text of a bill b, and (optional) knowledge about the politician (denoted K), and output a probability P(y = Yea|b, V, K) that politician p will vote Yea on bill b.
title: Roll Call Vote Prediction with Knowledge Augmented Models
